violated_contract: The All filter and a selection of every category are the same view and must both render as All. Loading a missing saved filter as every category left All unchecked, and tapping one category then removed it from the list instead of filtering to it.
canonical_prevention: A missing or empty saved filter loads as an empty selection, the selection collapses to empty when it covers every category, and the regression tests assert All on a first visit and manual-only after one tap.
